_comment: The channel map. ./setup creates each channel in your server and keeps the ids in etc/channels.local.json, which git ignores. mode is the default approval posture: auto acts, plan proposes first, approve needs a yes before any action, and read-only means Dexter reads the channel but never answers there. Blast radius sets the default, and any message can override it. Add, rename or delete channels here, then run ./setup again; update kernel/routing-table.json to match.

general.purpose: Discord's default channel. Scratch space; nothing routes here.

dexter.purpose: Main line to Dexter. Type here; Dexter decides where the work belongs and leaves a pointer.

inbox.purpose: Dexter asks, you answer. Buttons and polls land here so a reply is one tap.

skills.purpose: Live skill registry, regenerated daily from skills/. Invoke skills here.

queue.purpose: Deferred work, dependency-ordered. Nothing is dropped, only blocked.

log.purpose: Run history and routing decisions. Quiet unless you go looking.

thinking.purpose: Dexter's reasoning on long runs, as muted embeds so it never reads as an answer.

building.purpose: Building Dexter itself: features, architecture, what to build next. Skill tests report here.

experiments.purpose: Run things and see. Low blast radius on purpose, so Dexter acts without asking.

ideas.purpose: Ideas, captured verbatim. Distant connections get surfaced here.

learning.purpose: Reading paths, papers and explanations. The papers skill runs here.

notes.purpose: Your own notes: life, meetings, thinking. Dexter reads this for context and never writes here.

_writeComment: write=dexter means Dexter maintains the channel and you read it; you never file entries there by hand. Ask for a feature anywhere and Dexter writes the queue item itself. write=both means either side starts a conversation.
_categoryComment: Three sections. 'Yours' is your life and work: you write, Dexter replies. 'Builder' is the system building itself. 'Notes' is yours alone: Dexter reads it for context and never posts there.
